blind.description: A stylized fantasy ceramic specimen jar or pot. It features a bulbous amber-orange earthenware body embossed with dark brown swirling tentacle motifs, two looped ear handles at the shoulders, and a flared circular base sitting flat on the ground. The neck is sealed with a taut beige cloth or parchment cover secured by tied twine, from which a small blank rectangular parchment label hangs. Surfaces are clean, continuous, and stylized with hand-painted textures, free of floating pieces, holes, or untextured patches.
blind.from_above: A circular beige cloth lid tied with twine, framed by two symmetrical loop handles on either side, an embossed body with swirling relief patterns, and a small rectangular tag hanging off the rim.
blind.height_vs_figure: About one-third the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (roughly 2 ft / 60 cm tall) and around 1.5 ft wide.

notes: slightly stockier proportions than catalog target but clearly taller than wide
